title: Statusbar
description: x-statusbar pins a status bar to the bottom (or top) of the viewport with a message area in the middle. Any wb:status:message event on the document shows its message there for its duration (3s by default), styled by its type (error, success).

items.description: Comma-separated items. The first half go left of the message area, the rest right. Empty keeps the host's own children.

position.description: Edge the bar is pinned to. fixed is the same as bottom; any other value pins it nowhere.

_metadata.derivedFrom: navigation.js statusbar() — every property here is one the behavior reads
